properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Event Hubs: Managed Identity / RBAC Auth Required
properties.description: Audits Azure Event Hubs namespaces that do not have a managed identity configured. FedRAMP High requires identification and authentication (IA-2) and access enforcement (AC-3). Managed Identity enables RBAC-based authentication with Event Hubs Data Sender/Receiver roles, eliminating SAS key management and enabling centralized audit logging.

metadata.description: Audit: Report Event Hubs namespaces without managed identity. Deny: Block deployment. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
